concept: Final repaired relief freighter control-cassette handover at orbital shipyard
requester_hard_duties: Reference-guided original space-opera image; this testcase tests chosen realization without retroactively converting staging into requester locks.

required_visible: curved planetary limb outside the facility
construction/servicing dock structure around the spacecraft
gates.pass_rule: Both components are visibly external and spatially connected; a decorative starfield or spaceship interior alone fails.
gates.confusion_boundary: ordinary aircraft hangar, abstract corridor, generic spaceship bridge

required_visible: at least one visibly connected docking rib or servicing bridge
gates.pass_rule: The support/bridge must visibly meet the same ship hull, not merely float nearby.
gates.confusion_boundary: unattached rings or architectural ribs mistaken for shipyard

required_visible: smaller work craft or service structures
gates.pass_rule: At least three readable scales establish a vast working civilization.
gates.confusion_boundary: one large ship silhouette plus unrelated foreground portrait

required_visible: both hands in simultaneous contact with different sides of that same cassette
gates.pass_rule: All owners, object and contacts read together. Partial grip, hidden edge or duplicated object is fail.
gates.confusion_boundary: two people simply holding separate objects or shaking hands

required_visible: main figure face proportions compatible with supplied portrait
short dark bob with wispy fringe
gates.pass_rule: Face/hair can be compared from saved pixels; if face too small or occluded, partial or unobservable is fail. Identity is not scored.
gates.confusion_boundary: generic attractive face or matching hair alone

required_visible: engineer attention or expression directed to captain
gates.pass_rule: The scene supports completion and transfer as one moment, while unseen repair backstory remains unscored.
gates.confusion_boundary: unmotivated pose with background green light

required_visible: clear hierarchy from main face/contact to yard
gates.pass_rule: The central action is physically coherent and visually readable at saved image scale.
gates.confusion_boundary: correct labels with fused anatomy or decorative clutter

provider_block_rule: moderation_blocked yields no image and all pixel gates UNSCORED, no unchanged retry
causality_limit: An image can show genre realization and retrieval bindings, but one generation cannot prove that the data alone caused an artistic improvement.
